claim: A rope laid diagonally out of sprites shows gaps unless each piece begins inside the last one's end: the rope art (tile 513) leaves its tile at 33 of 38 columns and 50 of 52 rows, past which is a loose tuft.
evidence: the owner, 2026-11-25: 'diagonal ropes would need to have little bit of overlapping because how the texture is done, right now it has visible gaps'
tile 513's art measured in projects/blood-city/level/harbour_ship.py stay()
use: Lay each piece to reach 38/32 and 52/49 of its share so the next covers the tuft; stay() does it.
